title: --sudo option: 6-layer elevation architecture with pulse tracing (v5.14)
desc: v6.0 pipe separation: normal Eye -> wkappbot_eye_ipc (tick IPC only), admin Eye -> wkappbot_elevated (command proxy only). Must not mix -- normal Eye intercepted elevated connections before this split. --sudo is a SESSION START trigger. Launcher checks admin Eye liveness on wkappbot_elevated; reuses existing admin Eye if alive. Core/SudoHandler owns admin spawning, waits indefinitely after UAC until admin Eye ready OR spawned process dies. Once admin path started, no user-mode fallback; proxy failure aborts. User Eye refuses --sudo with [EYE:FALLBACK] + exit 125. IsAvailable->Ping migration for liveness. Proxy stdout/stderr captured as UTF-8 (StandardOutputEncoding=UTF8). Eye evict null cmdline = admin-elevated process, skip (not evict).
steps: v6.0 PIPE SEPARATION (CRITICAL): wkappbot_eye_ipc = normal Eye tick IPC ONLY (status/context/card broadcasts). wkappbot_elevated = admin Eye command proxy ONLY (sudo-elevated command routing). They must NEVER mix -- before split, normal Eye intercepted elevated connections causing session drift.

SEMANTIC MODEL -- --sudo is a SESSION START, not per-invocation. Once admin Eye (pipe wkappbot_elevated) is up, subsequent commands should inherit admin privilege without re-typing --sudo. Like shell sudo.
LAUNCHER: checks admin Eye liveness on wkappbot_elevated; prefers admin pipe over user pipe when admin Eye is alive. User Eye refuses --sudo with [EYE:FALLBACK] + exit 125.
CORE/SudoHandler: owns admin spawning, waits indefinitely after UAC until admin Eye ready OR spawned process dies. Once admin path started, no user-mode fallback; proxy failure aborts.
LIVENESS: IsAvailable -> Ping migration (active probe beats file existence check).
PROXY ENCODING: admin Eye subprocess stdout/stderr captured as UTF-8 (StandardOutputEncoding=UTF8 on ProcessStartInfo).
EYE EVICT RULE: null cmdline = admin-elevated process, skip (not evict). Otherwise normal Eye would kill the admin Eye it cannot inspect.
